newsitem.title: GREECE: OLYMPIC TO DECIDE ON NEW MEASURES AFTER UNION TALKS.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPIC TO DECIDE ON NEW MEASURES AFTER UNION TALKS.

text.p: Olympic Airways said on Tuesday it would talk to its employees before taking any decision on proposals to improve competitiveness and restructure the organisation of Greece's national carrier.

A final decision on implementation of the proposals would be taken by Olympic's administrative board after talks with workers' representatives and an evaluation of the operational and adminstrative needs of the company were completed, it said.
A report by management consulting firm McKinsey and Company contained "a package of substantial and documented proposals for the organisational structure of the company", it said.

McKinsey and Company were contracted to help Olympic Airways on a project, codenamed Olympic Airways 2000, to improve competitiveness above and beyond a financial restructuring plan devised by the Greek government and approved by the European Commission.

Olympic Airways posted a profit of about 9.9 billion drachmas ($40.4 million) in fiscal 1995 after 19 years of losses following the implementation of the financial restructuring which . --Maria Petrakis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
